title: Pragmatic Example Set for Component Evolution: tokens, buttons, tables, charts
creator: Maya Patel
description: Deliver a compact, hands-on collection of usage recipes and migration notes for tokens, buttons, tables, and charts to be published on the docs site. This ticket produces: (1) a short set of recommended patterns (Do / Don’t) for each component family, (2) three runnable examples per family that engineers can copy into the codebase, (3) a migration checklist for teams moving from legacy tokens/components to the current semantic API, and (4) updated API reference snippets (props, events, styling hooks). The goal is to reduce support questions and regressions by providing prescriptive examples, acceptance criteria, and explicit fallback guidance for older integrations.
acceptance_criteria: One-page summary card for each component family (tokens, buttons, tables, charts) with clear Do / Don’t guidance and an illustrative screenshot
At least three practical code examples per family (basic, accessibility-focused, and migration-shim) with copyable snippets and component props explained
Migration checklist that covers tokens rename mapping, deprecated props, and upgrade steps for client apps, published under the docs ‘Migration’ section
API reference blocks updated with prop types, default values, and short notes about performance/latency-sensitive props
Peer review from Engineering (runtime) and PM with sign-off comments resolved in docs PR
Docs built and smoke-tested in staging; links to failing examples and remediation steps included
migration_steps: Inventory: run tokens-audit script and export legacy token names to tokens-audit.csv
Map: translate legacy tokens to semantic names using provided mapping file (tokens-mapping-v2.csv); flag collisions and color contrasts
Shim: add a lightweight CSS shim for deprecated token aliases that logs a one-time warning in development builds
Buttons: identify deprecated props (variant=flat-legacy) and map to new semantic props (appearance=tertiary). Provide codemod for automated renames
Tables: advise on pagination prop changes and rowKey requirements; add migration snippet for custom cell renderers to new renderCell API
Charts: recommend switching from pixel-based size props to responsive container API; include example converting fixed-width chart to responsive chart with preserved axis labels
QA: run visual diff for key pages, accessibility checks (contrast, keyboard focus), and perf smoke tests for large table renders
Deploy: merge docs PR, publish docsite version docsite-2025.03, and announce deprecation windows to internal teams

author_notes: Focus the examples on common anti-patterns we've seen in support tickets: using tokens for layout spacing (should be design tokens only for color/typography), long-running table renders without virtualization, and over-styling buttons instead of relying on semantic variants. Keep each example under ~80 lines to improve copy-paste adoption.
